title: Heavy rain triggers flooding in Jammu’s Bohri and Anand Nagar, no casualties reported - KalingaTV
article_text:
Heavy rain triggers flooding in Jammu’s Bohri and Anand Nagar, no casualties reported
Intense rainfall inundated homes and roads in parts of Jammu on October 11, disrupting daily life during the first day of Navratri.
By Anustupa Mishra On Oct 11, 2026
Image Credit:- ANI
 Share

Jammu: Heavy rainfall triggered flooding in Bohri and Anand Nagar areas of Jammu on Sunday, October 11, with water entering homes and roads becoming waterlogged.

No casualties were reported in the incident.

MLA Arvind Gupta described the rainfall as unexpected, particularly as the monsoon season was nearing its end. He said flooding developed within around two hours and caused extensive damage in several areas.

The flooding also affected residents preparing for Navratri celebrations at home. The sudden downpour caught many families off guard on the first day of the festival.

Meanwhile, rainfall accompanied by hail and strong winds affected parts of Bandipora district in Jammu and Kashmir, damaging standing crops and raising concerns among farmers about potential agricultural losses.

title: IMD forecasts heavy rainfall over Bihar, Karnataka, Himachal Pradesh & Jammu-Kashmir - News On AIR
article_text:
India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Bihar, Karnataka, Himachal Pradesh, and Jammu-Kashmir for the day.

IMD said that conditions are becoming favourable for further withdrawal of Southwest Monsoon from some more parts of Eastern India and Northern Peninsula, and many parts of Northeast India during the next 2 to 3 days.

The Met Department said that thunderstorms and lightning conditions will continue over Delhi, Haryana, Chandigarh, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Mahe till tomorrow.
